diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..70bf6bb 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,17 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  if (input == null) return ''
+  return String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(/\p{M}+/gu, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, taken = []) {
+  const used = new Set(taken)
+  if (!used.has(base)) return base
+  let n = 2
+  while (used.has(`${base}-${n}`)) n++
+  return `${base}-${n}`
 }

All 4 tests pass.

## Changes

**`lib/slug.mjs`** — implemented the missing functionality:
- `slugify` — NFD-normalizes and strips combining marks (accents), lowercases, collapses any run of non-alphanumeric characters (spaces, dashes, punctuation) into a single `-`, and trims leading/trailing dashes.
- `uniqueSlug(base, taken)` — returns `base` if unused, otherwise appends the lowest free numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …).

**`index.mjs`** — added `uniqueSlug` to the export list, since `test.mjs` imports it from the package entry point but it wasn't exported.
